plan.fixed_background_scope: Inherited WorldClim cloud and remote monsoon background fields remain fixed; conditional regional solver, not fully independent global forecast.
plan.purpose: Paired physical mechanism test of common-pressure hydrostatic shear and conservative layer projection; no calibration or automatic adoption.

success.aggregation: Equal three regions, paired rainfall loss ratios; expose every regional regression; no individual rain veto.
success.interpretation: Process support only. No independent validation or atlas adoption; later excluded-region and resolution tests required.

plan.predicted_signature: Thermal vertical wind structure changes while exact dry continuity is retained; test whether this lowers actual rainfall error, not only native vector error.
plan.fixed_approximations: Common-reference modeled Tsl interpreted at101325Pa, smoothed500km; constant6K/km dry hydrostatic profile with200K floor; fixed-pressure derivative before local pressure integration; existing10degree Coriolis regularization. Existing provisional fixed-q weights for pre-solve rain/drying remain; actual reservoir water independently solved. No observed wind/humidity forcing.

interpretation: Fixed development-region mechanism test. Native improvements do not substitute for rainfall gains. No independent validation, global optimum claim or atlas climate adoption.
limitations: Three reused development regions; native925hPa masks sparse/empty over mountains.
Two-box winds; prescribed dry hydrostatic profile and common-pressure interpretation of modeled Tsl; no resolved momentum/vertical energy.
Existing10degree Coriolis regularization damps shear; provisional fixed-q diagnostics retained until actual water solve.
Fixed observed cloud/remote-monsoon backgrounds; conditional regional model.
NCEP monthly flux misses submonthly covariance; WorldClim period differs.
